title: LearnUP Standard API Response Envelope
description: Universal JSON envelope format returned for all synchronous HTTP REST endpoints.

success.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the operation succeeded (true) or failed (false).

data.description: Payload result for successful responses. Null when success is false or operation has no return data.

meta.description: Pagination metadata when the endpoint returns a list collection.

error.description: Structured error details when success is false. Null on successful responses.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of response generation.
